build_VJEPAModule: build a VJEPAModule with encoder, predictor, optimizer config, and masking settings for video self-supervised learning
run_training_step: run a training step on a batch of video frames with encoder and predictor masks
configure_optimizers: configure optimizers with decay and no-decay parameter groups plus online probe learning rates
forward_VJEPAModule: run forward pass computing JEPA prediction loss and regularization on masked video patches
update_target_encoder: update the target encoder using exponential moving average of the context encoder parameters
